_comment: Mutation testing for frontend helper modules. Excludes DOM-driven entry points, large data files, test fixtures, and the per-pixel scan analysis modules (pdf-deskew, pdf-trim, pdf-gray-image, pdf-page-sample), whose instrumented loops run their tests ~300x slower. See AGENTS.md > Frontend Mutation Testing.
_tsconfigFile_comment: Stryker's tsconfig preprocessor parses tsconfigFile with the TypeScript JS API (ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson), which TypeScript 7 no longer ships, so it crashes before testing anything. The preprocessor only rewrites extends/references paths that point outside the sandbox, and tsconfig.json has none, so it is pointed at a file that does not exist to skip it.
